about: Token vocabulary of the released models, fitted on the training period (before 2018) of the benchmark. Categorical values seen at least 20 times get their own id (2 + position in 'decode'); other values share 'hashed_buckets' ids by crc32 of the value; 0 = padding, 1 = missing. 'amt' and 'gap' hold quantile bin edges.
